description: Flutter hobby projects versus a mid-level mobile role asking for released apps and CI; several partial matches expected.
job_description:
Mobile Developer (Flutter)

About the role
You will own features end to end in our Flutter app used by 500k users.

Requirements
- 2+ years of professional Flutter development with at least one app published on the App Store or Google Play
- Strong Dart skills and experience with a state management solution (Bloc, Riverpod or Provider)
- Experience integrating REST APIs and handling authentication tokens securely
- Familiarity with automated testing in Flutter (widget and integration tests)
- Experience with CI/CD for mobile (Codemagic, Fastlane or GitHub Actions)
- Bonus: native iOS or Android experience
resume:

- Habit Tracker: Flutter app with local SQLite storage; wrote widget tests for the main screens.

Experience

Skills
